messages.text: BL-1775 🎵 in progress — A second swarm never runs with the primary's Telegram identity - zsh sources ~/.zshenv, which exports the primary's TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, into swarmforge.sh and every role launch script, so gpu-bargain-hunter's handoffd and coordinator carry swarmforgevc's bot and chat (verified by hash 2026-09-26); a swarm that is not the recorded primary root applies its own fleet creds, or none, in its launcher and in every role launch script after the shell profile, and the primary is unchanged
